concept_label: 是否参加至少一种非机关/企业基本养老保险项目
construct: Participation in at least one listed pension program
value_semantics: 1=Yes; 2=No. Question explicitly excludes government/institution pension and firms' basic pension. A No response routes past FN039 to FN071.
mapping_status: official 2011 questionnaire and codebook reviewed; candidate mapping
caveat: 2011 baseline pension participation construct. Do not conflate with current pension receipt, benefit amounts, contribution status, or the separate government/institution and firm basic pension question. Respondent-level analysis eligibility and missingness must follow the official route.
